text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3cfe245ae5f381f8a4dffad6c29154d0 as of 2026-09-02T22:30:43.783Z: {"title":"Arthur McInnis · Council · chal"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"⚖️"} **Filled card. Not published.** Arthur McInnis · Council · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. **Second pass, 2 Sep 2026 (evening):** all ten article hubs now read in full, plus the site sitemap, the 25 Jun launch coverage, a signed 18 Apr Victoria News letter, the Livable CRD questionnaire status and the campaign-linked Facebook forum. Three dashes converted and one mark moved up. **Scored answers 22 → 25. Internal proposal B+ → B.** Challenger: no 2022–26 City term, so no Record lines and no incumbent haircut. 2026 plan taken at face value. ## Card
Field Value
Name Arthur McInnis
Office Council
Kind chal (no 2022–26 City term — 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut)

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **said** "Any proposed property tax increase above the rate of inflation will require a mandatory 90-day public consultation period before Council may adopt it." A consultation gate, not a cap, a formula, or a year-path. Names no residential-rate number. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** Raises downtown but names no order instrument: "When they go downtown, they can't find parking, they can't get where they want to go quickly, and they don't feel safe." No Public Order Team, no unified command, no bylaw-hours position anywhere on `/platform` or in hubs 1–10. Safety performance contract and community paramedicine are scored on rows 35 and 32, not here. [https://vicnews.com/2026/06/25/back-to-basics-james-bay-lawyer-educator-runs-for-victoria-council/](https://vicnews.com/2026/06/25/back-to-basics-james-bay-lawyer-educator-runs-for-victoria-council/) published 2026-06-25 · retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **said** "Any development receiving a rezoning, density bonus, or access to public land must meet minimum unit-mix requirements: a defined percentage of two-bedroom and three-bedroom suites, and a defined percentage of ground-oriented units." Thresholds left to an amended OCP. Missing middle as the default form is the same housing cluster, not a second door. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **said** "When Council approves a budget, the public communication should include an honest estimate of what a typical homeowner, accounting for school tax, regional levies, policing, and debt will likely see on their actual notice." All-in residential communication, not a named combined water/sewer/stormwater Household Bill. Verb FLAG in working notes. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with a five-plank long-form platform (open government and fiscal responsibility; neighbourhood planning and responsible growth; housing affordability and tenant protection; transportation; public safety and order), ten article hubs, biography, donations and volunteer forms. Written and current. No costed city-wide budget, no residential-rate formula, no unit-volume target. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Close 2.0** "Any development receiving a rezoning, density bonus, or access to public land must meet minimum unit-mix requirements: a defined percentage of two-bedroom and three-bedroom suites, and a defined percentage of ground-oriented units." · Commits × Comparable. Family mix named; thresholds "will be set in an amended OCP," so not 25/20/15/30 and not Aligned. No 12,000-home volume target. Context, same plank, not a second mark: missing middle (duplexes, triplexes, courtyard housing, townhomes, laneway homes, small apartments) as the preferred growth form. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops **Close 2.0** "The city will not sell municipally owned land for housing. Instead, underused city parcels, including surface parking lots, surplus works yards, and air rights above civic facilities will be offered on long-term nominal leases to housing co-ops and non-profit providers." · Commits × Comparable. 99-year-style leasehold to co-ops/non-profits is the land-bank half, not a named acquisition fund. Civic overbuild (housing feasibility on civic rebuilds) is the same land-for-housing cluster, not a second mark. The civic-land *map* is scored on row 44. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time standard, no one-stop centre, no e-permitting, no AI pre-screening anywhere on `/platform` or in hubs 1–10. The "expedited permit stream" sits inside the pattern-book sentence already scored on row 4; the "concierge permitting service" sits inside the amnesty sentence scored on row 5. **Considered and rejected this pass:** "priority processing for owner-occupied and long-term rental forms" is M7's tenure-based priority queue in substance, but it sits inside the reduced-DCC-and-permit-fee sentence, and the template assigns DCC cuts to row 5. One sentence, one measure — so row 3 stays a dash rather than taking a second mark off a sentence row 5 already owns. "Infrastructure Before Upzoning" (certified capacity report before significant upzoning) is a condition on the approval path, not a clock, and runs the opposite way from M7's speed commitment. Do not resolve a dash into Opposed. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing **Aligned 3.0** "The city will develop a pattern book of pre-approved duplex, triplex, townhome, and laneway home designs available to any applicant, qualifying automatically for an expedited permit stream." · Commits × Same instrument. Designs prioritise family-appropriate unit sizes. Template example sentence, re-sourced from the live `/platform` on this retrieve, not copied from the template card. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty **Close 2.0** "The city will establish a time-limited permit amnesty for suites meeting basic safety standards, paired with a standardised approval package and concierge permitting service." · Commits × Comparable. M8b amnesty and concierge both named; no 24-month window and no life-safety-only test, and no 5% vacancy target, so not Aligned. Context, same plank, not a second mark: "The city will establish a reduced DCC and permit fee schedule for missing middle and family-oriented infill, with priority processing for owner-occupied and long-term rental forms" — this is the sentence the template's "DCC cuts" wording assigns here, which is why row 3 and row 19 cannot take a mark off it. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No unified command, co-location, or downtown operations desk. Confirmed across `/platform` and all ten hubs this pass. Safety performance contract is scored on row 35. Community paramedicine is scored on row 32. OCP safety benchmarks are the same safety plank, not a Public Order Team. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Community paramedicine is scored once, on row 32. That is not a civilian crisis-response team dispatched so the wrong responder stops absorbing officer time. Hub 6's "Stop asking VicPD to do the province's job" is the same regional/provincial cluster used on rows 33 and 16, not a City crisis team. No CRCL / IMCRT naming. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. `/platform` and all ten hubs checked this pass. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No focused-deterrence model, no hotspot publication, no Crown liaison. The safety dashboard is scored on row 35, not as M28 targeting. Hub 6's "Fold transit-corridor disorder explicitly into the city's public safety data and reporting" is reporting scope inside row 35's cluster, not a targeting instrument. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — No keep / repeal / replace of daytime sheltering rules. Hub 6's North Park and CSWB articles diagnose street disorder; diagnosis without an instrument is a Mention, so a dash. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — No child-focused protected list, no VicPD/CDSA coordination position, no City seizure claim. `/platform` and all ten hubs checked this pass. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — No rapid-removal protocol, no named-space reclaim geography, no capacity-first publication, no night-lighting programme. "Compassion without accountability eventually fails both the public and the vulnerable" is a frame, not an encampment instrument. Mentions dash. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) **Close 2.0** "Any proposed property tax increase above the rate of inflation will require a mandatory 90-day public consultation period before Council may adopt it." · Commits × Comparable. An inflation gate with a public-covenant consultation, not a 6.5 / 5.0 / CPI-plus-growth path and not a 6-of-9 override. Do not stamp 10.44 as the current ACTW lock (the residential lock is 9.34). Context, same plank, not a second mark: "This is a policy commitment to fiscal discipline not a legal straitjacket, but a public covenant with residents." [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — Hub 4 diagnoses a 58.6% jump in municipal debt charges on one notice, and hub 8 tracks the 2025 provincial change letting municipalities borrow for capital without a referendum or AAP. Both are diagnoses, not a refund threshold, a debt-service ceiling, a protected debt-reduction contribution, or a supermajority override. Mentions, so a dash. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill **Close 2.0** "When Council approves a budget, the public communication should include an honest estimate of what a typical homeowner, accounting for school tax, regional levies, policing, and debt will likely see on their actual notice." · Commits × Comparable. All-in residential communication is the Household Bill's purpose; water, sewer, solid waste and stormwater are not named as a combined number and there is no five-year forward trajectory. FLAG: the hub frames this as what residents should get from Council while he is running for that Council — ambiguity up to Commits, not a dash. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger **Close 2.0** "Formally advocate to the Province for a legislative framework requiring it to fully fund and operate mental health, addictions, and complex care services." · Commits × Comparable. A refusal to keep absorbing provincial care onto the municipal tax base is the downloading goal; no quarterly published ledger, no per-file cost estimate, no named refusal threshold, so not Aligned. Context, hub 6, not a second mark: "Stop asking VicPD to do the province's job." [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — CRD and regional levies appear on the sample tax notice in hub 4 as a diagnosis of the combined bill, already used toward row 15. No published annual regional position, no CRD voting record duty, no Goldstream filtration-plant staging position. Dash. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office — The downtown business liaison is scored once, on row 31, as a security-cost sentence. No 11%→5% storefront-vacancy target, no vacancy surcharge advocacy, no business-licence clock, no Strategic Economic Plan, no employment-lands inventory. Hub 4's Crystal Pool and Centennial Square articles are capital-stewardship critique, not an economic mandate. — —
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No \$25M capital-approval threshold, no 15-minute meter grace, no first-hour Year-2 gate. M76's small-renovation fee relief is the reduced-DCC-and-permit-fee sentence already owned by row 5 — one sentence, one measure. FLAG, unchanged: his Public Parking Infrastructure Replacement Policy (\$60–75K per stall into a Parking Infrastructure Reserve; parkades at Centennial Square, Wharf Street, Royal Athletic Park) is a real programme and a different instrument from M75 short-stay access — and the Program records it as a **declined import**, so it cannot score here. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — Hub 4 challenges the legal basis of the Reconciliation Contribution Fund on the tax notice. That is a process and jurisdiction critique, not a standing G2G table, a procurement target, a place-name programme, a cultural-protocol package, or an urban Indigenous liaison. **Not Opposed, and now sourced rather than inferred:** "reconciliation with Indigenous peoples is a genuine obligation, and the Songhees and Xwsepsum Nations deserve better than what this program delivers. Again, what I am challenging here is not the goal. It is the legal foundation, the jurisdictional basis, and the process." Topic stays in the 12. A dash is unknown, not a fail. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-4-budget) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "Any redevelopment that demolishes purpose-built rental housing must replace every demolished unit with a new rental unit on the same site. No net loss of rental inventory." · Commits × Comparable. One-for-one replacement is a demoviction-protection instrument. Context, same plank, not a second mark: the lesser-of right of return; the independent Tenant Relocation Coordinator reporting to the city; rent top-up for tenants of 10+ years. No 12-month notice period, no STR licensing or cap, and no indoor-heat standard on the live `/platform` this retrieve (June internal notes of a 3% STR trigger are not on the site and are not used). M9c struck. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — No single portal, no published point-based scoring, no queue-position transparency. `/platform` and all ten hubs checked this pass. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — Protecting existing rental stock is scored on row 21. Non-market and co-op land is scored on row 2. Hub 6's "\$10 Million Later, Victoria Can't Tell You How Many People Are Off the Street" carries **no commitment block** — it is diagnosis and a question put to voters, with no 50% unsheltered target and no STEP throughput. Verified this pass against the full hub text. Mentions, so a dash. Not Housing First by name. — —
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — Family unit-mix is scored on row 1. No 500 childcare spaces, no 60-day childcare permit clock, no s.224 exemption for primary-care clinics, no 18–25 programme. Professional background is not a source. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools appear as a capacity item inside "Infrastructure Before Upzoning," and hub 8's SD61 material is about trustee endorsements, not a City–Board agreement. Both are Mentions of schools, not a standing SD61 agreement, joint-use facilities agreement, or named City contact. Mentions dash every column. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear as 2026 instruments. `/platform` and all ten hubs checked this pass. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Close 2.0** "Require a published, ranked, dated list of the city's highest-collision locations, updated annually with the city's own data, so residents, not just staff, can see which intersections are next and when." · Commits × Comparable. A ranked collision-evidence capital sequence is M38's prioritisation rule delivered through a published list, not adaptive signals and not an automated-enforcement site list. M39 struck. Context, same cluster, not a second mark: "Tie capital prioritisation to injury severity, not just project readiness"; the emergency-response audit of corridor redesigns and the OCP Emergency Access Overlay; and hub 5's Option F commitment. The Island Rail Corridor line is a Mention of M22, not a mode endorsement or a right-of-way protection, and carries no mark. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls **Close 2.0** "Concretely, within the first term I would direct city staff to prepare a feasibility report on inner harbour water transit integration, including: an assessment of potential routes and ridership; a financial model for a public service agreement versus continued private operation; a review of the SeaBus integration process and its applicability to Victoria's context; and a preliminary framework for negotiations with Victoria Harbour Ferry and BC Transit." · Commits × Comparable. **Converted from a dash this pass.** M23b's instrument is a City-side transit position that is produced, published and carried to the transit authority; this is a dated, first-term, City-directed and published transit analysis used as the basis for formal advocacy — a comparable instrument, not the annual Council-adopted position and not a transit-priority capital line. **Most contestable mark on the card** (see Fragility). Pressing the Province on the BC Transit funding gap remains a Mention and carries nothing. Walking and the M20b sidewalk-gap standard do not appear at all. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-5-transit](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-5-transit) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "Accessibility for those who cannot cycle" inside neighbourhood street-change assessments is a Mention, not a published accessibility audit methodology and not a public-washroom spacing standard. Dash. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "roads come before discretionary programs" sits inside the zero-based sentence already scored on row 41. One sentence, one measure. No pothole clock, no condition-based prioritisation, no backlog standard. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading **Partial 1.0** "Establish a dedicated city liaison for downtown businesses facing the direct costs of theft, vandalism, and reduced foot traffic." · Commits × Neither. A liaison is an action, not an exposure-based, capped, sunsetted cost-spreading pilot. Face-test Partial, not Close. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
32 M28d community paramedicine **Aligned 3.0** "I will fund a City partnership contribution and formally advocate to the Province to bring community paramedicine to Victoria as a permanent urban program, not another pilot that disappears." · Commits × Same instrument, including M28d's own "permanent urban" wording. Jurisdiction note on the same page: BCEHS delivers; the City funds a partnership and advocates. Not double-counted as M26b. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) **Close 2.0** "Pursue the regional and Esquimalt-style integration model seriously, rather than as a talking point sharing specialised units and back-office functions across municipalities frees sworn officers for the front line without waiting on a hiring pipeline that the whole province is competing for." · Commits × Comparable. Regional integration and shared units is the M29b goal with a harder instrument than convene-and-publish; the Program forbids binding another force, so not Aligned. Context, same hub and plank, not a second mark: "Compress the staffing timeline... and require staff to report publicly, every quarter, on progress against that compressed target"; "Restore the two cut VicPD positions as an immediate step." FLAG vs the 1 Sep pack's Partial 1.0, which used only the restore-two sentence. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/hub-6-safety) lastmod 2026-08-12 · retrieved 2026-09-02
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting, the IoT platform and the five explicit surveillance Nos do not appear. `/platform` and all ten hubs checked this pass. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target **Aligned 3.0** "Convert the həlisət plan from a narrative document into a performance contract. Every major commitment must identify: legal authority, responsible lead body, implementation timeline, measurable target, and projected cost." · Commits × Same instrument — M31c's five mandatory fields, named one for one. Context, same cluster, not a second mark: a real-time public safety dashboard modelled on Hamilton and Toronto; quarterly reporting on crime trends, street disorder, response times and shelter placements; and hub 6's "Require that any future Community Safety and Wellbeing reporting explicitly track hate-motivated incidents as a distinct category, with public, comparable, year-over-year numbers." Distinct from the taxpayer capital portal on row 42. No 15% crime-reduction number, so M32 is context only. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues **Close 2.0** "Any rezoning or development permit application affecting a designated or registered heritage property will require an independent Heritage Impact Assessment prepared by a qualified heritage professional at the applicant's cost published as part of the public record before the hearing." · Commits × Comparable. A mandatory HIA is a heritage-standards instrument, not a design code, a facade-restoration fund, or a cultural-venue right of first refusal. Context, hub 10, not a second mark: the argument that heritage assets are treated as leverage for density rather than public goods requiring dedicated stewardship plans. Not Aligned. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — No pedestrianisation pilot, no reversal decision rule, no signature-project shortlist or referendum. Opposing Option F is a neighbourhood-consent and emergency-access sentence used as context on row 27, not a pedestrianisation programme. Hub 3's Centennial Square material is capital critique. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Local DCC reinvestment into neighbourhood parks sits in the neighbourhood cluster already scored on row 53. Hub 9's proposed 30% permeable at-grade green-space minimum is a development standard, not waterfront walkway completion, ornamental lighting hours, or a Parks horticulture uplift. Dash. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Hub 3's Hermann's Jazz Club articles and hub 4's Royal BC Museum piece diagnose how cultural space is lost; hub 4's Crystal Pool and Royal Athletic Park material is capital stewardship. None is an arts funding floor, extended civic hours, a night-market programme, or a sport-facility restoration. Dash. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — "Where practical, I will pursue shared services with neighbouring municipalities, joint procurement, shared back-office functions, and coordinated capital planning" is a cost-reduction instrument between municipalities, not competitive testing of the City's own operation against private bidders on one specification. Not M15. Hub 4's point that no independent value-for-money analysis was commissioned on Crystal Pool is a procurement critique, not a managed-competition commitment. Dash, not Partial. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Aligned 3.0** "End automatic annual departmental increases. Every department justifies its baseline spending each year against core service priorities: fire, police, water, sewers, and roads come before discretionary programs." · Commits × Same instrument in substance — zero-based baselines, annually, across all departments. The rotating 3–4 service areas per cycle and the published three-part grant test are not named; annual-all-departments is ZBB, not a weaker cousin. The roads-first language in this sentence is not given a second mark on row 30. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Close 2.0** "Launch a publicly accessible digital portal tracking all major capital projects: e.g. Crystal Pool, the Community Safety Plan, street redesigns with budget vs. actual spending updated in real time." · Commits × Comparable. A real-time capital portal is faster in cadence but far narrower than M67's 20+ named series. Distinct from the safety dashboard on row 35. The \$10 FOI-fee abolition in the same numbered action is context on row 52, not here. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear as instruments. Hub 4's HR-director job-posting critique is a hiring-process critique, not an attrition target. ZBB is scored on row 41. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation **Close 2.0** "Publish a full public map of every city-owned parcel, including surface parking lots, works yards, air rights, and surplus buildings. Report annually on what each parcel produces in public benefit and whether it meets OCP housing targets before adjacent private land is up-zoned." · Commits × Comparable. Inventory plus a utilization and public-benefit audit is the first half of M69. He explicitly declines the sell half ("The city will not sell municipally owned land for housing"), so not Aligned. The 99-year leases are scored on row 2 and are not a second mark here. [https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform](https://www.arthurmcinnis.ca/platform) lastmod 2026-07-17 · retrieved 2026-09-02
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — No utility-GIS migration, no AI consultation imagery, no LIDAR commitment. Hub 9 cites the City's own 2023 LiDAR canopy assessment as evidence; citing an existing City dataset is not a commitment to commission one. Dash. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear anywhere on `/platform` or in hubs 1–10. Professional and legal background is not a source. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — The open-data flavour of the taxpayer portal is scored on row 42. No local-preference scoring, no innovation pilot framework, no data-sovereignty rule, no air-quality sensors, no public Wi-Fi, no EV-charging programme. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic **Partial+ 1.5** "...a district energy feasibility assessment tied to rezoning approval, accompanied by binding low-carbon infrastructure obligations reflecting the assessment's conclusions; and the establishment of both construction and operational emissions baselines together with mandatory monitoring and reporting obligations at defined intervals." · Agrees × Comparable. **Converted from a dash this pass.** Written as what a compliant Bayview agreement should have required rather than "I will," so Agrees, not Commits. Feasibility-first district energy then binding obligations is comparable to M58b's study-then-utility rule, applied developer-side at rezoning rather than City-side downtown.
